Priya S: Quick check — Acme POC is closing next week. Need a short, repeatable cleanup runbook for them: keys, dedicated pool, VPC endpoints, and retention. Who owns what?
Alex K: I can own the Dedicated pool teardown and confirm GPU job drain. Will need a 1hr maintenance window.
Priya S: Thanks. They asked for retained logs for 90 days only, then purge. Legal confirmed.
Maria T: Security notes: rotate any long-lived API keys now, then invalidate after final handoff. Also ensure S3 buckets have lifecycle policy set (90d -> archive -> delete).
Jordan L: I'll send the customer the final handback checklist. Can we provide a short script for them to rotate hosted keys and verify no active tokens?
Sam I: For Private/VPC: need their point-of-contact to confirm route table changes. We should snapshot firewall rules before teardown (for audit). I can run the snapshot and attach to the ticket.
Priya S: Good. Can we outline exact commands so customer can do the hosted key rotation without waiting on us?
Alex K: Yup. Example for rotating hosted key via console/API: 
```
# create new key (returns key_id)
POST /v1/keys -d '{"label":"acme-poc-temp-2"}' -H "Authorization: Bearer <admin>"
# verify no usage
GET /v1/keys/<key_id>/usage
# then expire old key
POST /v1/keys/<old_key_id>/expire
```
Jordan L: I'll include that snippet in the handoff email. Keep it simple.
Maria T: Also include the internal compliance checklist:
- confirm keys rotated and old key expired
- dedicated pool deleted + pool_id in ticket
- VPC endpoints removed and peering detached (if used)
- logs exported to customer-approved storage for 90d
- evidence (screenshots/IDS logs) uploaded to the case
Sam I: infra-bot: request pool deletion for pool-id: dp-4519 by 2024-05-08 18:00 UTC
infra-bot: Pool deletion job queued: job-9921. ETA ~20m after drain completes.
Priya S: Perfect. Can someone own archiving the logs for 90 days? We need a single link we can give the customer.
Alex K: I'll export request logs and model invocation logs to their S3 bucket (they provided ARN). Upload confirmation + MD5 in the ticket.
Maria T: I'll run the final keys audit after Alex confirms exports. If anything unexpected, tag me immediately.
Jordan L: I'll draft the email and attach the runbook + commands. Send me the job id once infra-bot posts completion.
infra-bot: job-9921 completed: pool dp-4519 removed. Artifacts: /archives/poc/acme/requests-1715.tar.gz
Priya S: Awesome. Alex, Maria — can one of you post the archive link and the expired-key audit here so I can close the POC?
Alex K: Archive link: s3://acme-poc-exports/requests-1715.tar.gz (MD5: 9b3f2c...)
Maria T: Keys audit: old key `k_old_89` expired 1715001800; no usages after rotation. Ticket updated with screenshots.
Priya S: Closing checklist satisfied. I'll send final closure email to the customer and mark the POC as complete. Thanks all :tada:
